source:
@@U03878@@
Follow me into airy regions! Follow me down into dismal abysses! Catch me, go on, let’s see you do it!

@@U03880@@
(Shaking off the last of the flames.)

@@U03881@@
How cramped this press of rocks and tangled brush! This is no place for youth and vigor! I hear the rush of soaring winds and the roaring crash of waves— so far away— if only I were there!

@@U03882@@
(He leaps higher and higher up the rocks.)

@@U03884@@
Why must you outdo the mountain goat? How dreadful if you fall.

@@U03886@@
I must mount higher, I must see farther! I know now where | am. In the middle of an island, 珀罗普斯'’ isle, water one side, land the other.

@@U03888@@
Come linger here in peace in mountain and forest. We'll seek out grapes, whole hillsides of grapes, fig trees and arbors with golden apples. Stay gently here, gently, in this gentle land.

@@U03890@@
Is it peace you're dreaming of? Then dream away! War’s the watchword! War that leads on to victory!
translation:
@@U03878@@
跟随我进入通风区域！跟我一起跌入悲惨的深渊吧！抓住我，继续，让我们看看你怎么做！

@@U03880@@
（甩掉最后一丝火焰。）

@@U03881@@
这些岩石和纠结的灌木丛压得多么狭窄啊！这里不是青春和活力的地方！我听到呼啸的风声和咆哮的海浪声——那么遥远——如果我在那里就好了！

@@U03882@@
（他在岩石上跳得越来越高。）

@@U03884@@
为什么你一定要胜过山羊呢？万一摔倒了，那是多么可怕啊。

@@U03886@@
我一定要爬得更高，我一定要看得更远！我现在知道在哪里了|是。珀罗普斯岛位于一座岛屿的中央，一侧是水，另一侧是陆地。

@@U03888@@
来到这里，在山林间享受宁静的时光。我们将寻找葡萄、满山的葡萄、无花果树和挂满金苹果的凉亭。轻轻地停留在这里，轻轻地，在这片温柔的土地上。

@@U03890@@
这是你梦想的和平吗？那就做梦吧！战争是口号！战争必将走向胜利！
